---
title: stat-smooth
subtitle: "Smoother statistic: closed-form linear fit with a pointwise confidence band."
category: Stats
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Returns a dense grid of `(x, y, ymin, ymax)` rows where `y` is the fitted
value and `ymin`/`ymax` bound a pointwise confidence band.

## Usage

```typst
stat-smooth(
  method: "lm",
  se: true,
  level: 0.95,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `method` | `"lm"` | Smoother method. `"lm"` is the only supported value in v1. |
| `se` | `true` | Whether to compute the confidence band. When `false`, `ymin == ymax == y`. |
| `level` | `0.95` | Confidence level for the band (e.g. `0.95`). |

## Returns

Statistic object with `name: "smooth"`, consumed by geom layers.

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/stat-smooth-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = range(0, 20).map(i => (
  x: i,
  y: i * 0.5 + calc.sin(i * 0.4) * 2,
))
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (
    geom-point(size: 2pt),
    geom-smooth(method: "lm"),
  ),
)
```
